title: TherapistTranscriptEvent
description: Contract 2 (v1.0.0) outbound WebSocket event pushed from Team 5 Orchestrator to Team 1 Therapist React UI (/ws/therapist).

turnId.description: Optional turn identifier correlating with the audio/animation turn.

speaker.description: Speaker role for the transcript line.

text.description: Transcribed child speech, character reply, or system notice (UTF-8 Hebrew).

animationTriggerId.description: Animation trigger chosen for CHARACTER turns.

timestampMs.description: Server Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
